# RAPIDD chiral EFT responses: Hu2022_SD (read by rapidd.chiral_eft, not by read_nuclear_responses)
# Ab initio (VS-IMSRG) one-body SD responses of B. S. Hu et al., PRL 128, 072502 (2022), arXiv:2109.00193, for
#   the chiral interactions 1.8/2.0(EM) (EM1.8_2.0), N4LO+3N_lnl (N4LO_LNL2) and Delta NNLO_GO(394) (DNNLOgo):
#   their spread is the nuclear uncertainty of the LZ 2024 SD limits. Coefficients copied from the data_fit files
#   read by the notebook https://github.com/BaishanHu/AbInitio4DarkMatter (ChEFT_SpinDependent,
#   DarkMatter_ChEFT_SD.ipynb, commit e10cccbbdb4b792a52b1352519ef9454eb1e403d of 2021-10-02, downloaded
#   2026-11-24), with the same digits.
#
# F_O^tau(u) = exp(-u/2) * sum_{k=0}^{5} a_k u^k,  u = (q b)^2 / 2, b = hbar c / sqrt(m_N hbar omega) [fm] with
#   the hbar omega = 16 MeV of the IMSRG basis (as in the notebook; not the A-dependent formula of HKMS and HMS)
#   and m_N = (m_p + m_n)/2 = 938.9187 MeV.
# Isospin basis tau = +, - with F_+- = F_p +- F_n (not divided by 2, unlike the iso_* tables). Responses:
#   Sp = Sigma', Spp = Sigma''; L the multipole; J the spin of the nucleus. Spin expectation values of each
#   interaction in spin_expectation.txt. The corrections delta', delta'' (two-body currents with the
#   low-energy constants of each interaction) are computed in rapidd/chiral_eft.py as in the notebook.
#   Lookup: the row with the same A, Z, O, tau, L and interaction.
#
#   A   Z  O    tau  L  interaction    J         b               a0               a1               a2               a3               a4               a5
